business_rules.rule: If (RISK-CD >= 1 AND RISK-CD <= 3), then LIMIT-AMT is set to 500000.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If the risk code (RISK-CD) is between 1 and 3 (inclusive), then the limit amount (LIMIT-AMT) is set to 500,000.

business_rules.rule: If (NOT (RISK-CD >= 1 AND RISK-CD <= 3)) AND ((RISK-CD = 5) OR (RISK-CD >= 7 AND RISK-CD <= 9)), then LIMIT-AMT is set to 50000.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If not (the risk code (RISK-CD) is between 1 and 3 (inclusive)) and (the risk code is 5 or the risk code is between 7 and 9 (inclusive)), then the limit amount (LIMIT-AMT) is set to 50,000.
